entries.name: multi-git
entries.description: 多仓库 Git 总览：工作区内每个仓库的变更、差异、历史、分支、贮藏、跨仓搜索与时间线，另有工作区分支聚合、Fetch/Pull 与内置终端（其余只读）。
entries.descriptionEn: Multi-repo Git overview: changes, diffs, history, branches, stashes, cross-repo search and a timeline for every repository in the workspace, plus a workspace-wide branch view, Fetch/Pull and an optional terminal.
